question: India won the U19 Asia Cup Cricket, 2021, by defeating _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sri Laka.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Year 2021 **ended on the correct note for the** U-19 Indian **justice platoon because it lifted the U-19 Asia Cup after beating Sri Lanka by nine lattices during a match that was intruded by rain on Friday in Dubai.
 
• Traipsing first, the Ceylon U-19 side was reduced to **106/9 in 38 overs** as rain played killjoy within the final.
 
• Vicky Oswal sailed brilliantly to assert three lattices for** 11 runs **in eight overs. In reply, the India U-19 side was set a revised **target of 102 runs** which it ultimately chased down in** 21.3 overs** with nine lattices remaining.
 
• Opening batter Angkrish Raghuvanshi played a fine knock as India chased without important fuss.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Asian Cricket Council Asia Cup is a men's **One Day International **and Twenty20 International cricket tournament. 
 
• It was established in 1983 when the Asian Cricket Council was founded as a measure to promote goodwill between Asian countries.
 
• The first Asia cup was held **in 1984** in Sharjah in the United Arab Emirates.
 
• India has also won the most 7 titles out of **12 Asia Cup tournaments.**
